column1: # Bryo: every control, by context and gesture. One row per (context, control, gesture). Tab separated; lines
# starting with # are comments; the first other line is the header. tests/controls_check.py validates it.
# context   where the row applies: any | power-on | page (any device or slot page) | page:tape | page:grain |
#           page:resonator | page:color | page:space | page:drum (a DRUM track's own pages) | page:arp (the arpeggiator's page) | page:slot | mixer (GLO's
#           view) | glo-held | slot-held | scl-held (SCL down: the reset) |
#           slot-held+step (a SEQ slot's pad and a white key held) | project-view | routing-view | usb-record (the
#           USB record mode: REC held a second)
# control   BTN_<label> (the 14 buttons) | ENC_<role> (the 7 encoders) | POT_MASTER | WHITE_<n> (1..16, or a
#           range n-m) | BLACK_<label> (OP1..OP6 PIT GLO MONO POLY ZERO, left to right)
# gesture   press | tap (down and up within HOLD) | hold | release | turn | hold-turn (turn while the context's
#           pad is held) | combo (held together with what the context names)
# status    now (in the firmware, tested in tests/bryo_host.c) | planned (the PRD, in the phase named) |
#           proposed (mine, waiting for a decision) | unassigned
# phase     the build phase (docs/bryo-architecture.md) where it lands; - for now
# source    PRD section, or "change" (agreed in conversation), or "kept" (from Felucca)

column4: action
master output level (digital gain after the mix; USB follows unless USB LEVEL FIXED)
held with OCT+ for 5 s: UPDATE MODE countdown from 2 s, letting go cancels
held with OCT+ at power-on: HARDWARE CALIBRATION (press each button, turn each encoder)

focus the track's source (TAPE, SYNTH, POLY or DRUM) as HOME is let go (held for SELECT or a DRUM key: no page turn); again: its next page (TAPE 2, TAPE 3; SYNTH's AMP, FILTER, VOICE, LEVEL; POLY's ENV, FILTER, LEVEL), round. Every source's last page has LVL on KNOB 4 (-24..+6 dB: what the track hears of it, the S-4's LEVEL)

focus GRAIN; again: GRAIN 2 (WET SPRY CONT REV), GRAIN 3 (SCAN WARP OFST FDBK), GRAIN 4 (PATN SCAL PRND ROUT); again: RESONATOR, RESONATOR 2 (CUT RES TYPE SCAL), RESONATOR 3 (- - - ROUT); again: GRAIN. ROUT on GRAIN, RESONATOR and COLOR: INS (WET crossfades the dry with the device) or SEND (the dry at full, the device added at WET)
focus COLOR; again: COLOR 2 (NDEC NTON CMOD WET), COLOR 3 (- - ROUT LVL: ROUT left of LVL, as on every page with both); again: SPACE, SPACE 2 (DLY VERB TONE SPRD), SPACE 3 (PRE)

the LFO pad's modulator: M1, M2 or M3 (the three swappable slots, each an LFO, ADSR or FOLLOW; LFO held + OP1 OP2 OP3 picks which, M1 to start), its page as the pad is let go; again: its next page. Every engine's last page ends AMT OFS on KNOB 3-4. Held, it sets depths instead (slot-held)
M2's page as the pad is let go (default engine ADSR; it can be swapped, as M1 and M3); again: its next page (ADSR: 3: stages, curves, VEL LOOP AMT OFS)
M4's page, the step sequencer (always a SEQ: its engine doesn't swap), as the pad is let go; again: its page 2 (DIR TRIG PROB STRT), page 3 (- SPRD AMT OFS)
the arpeggiator's page (arp.c, not a modulator): MODE ORDR RNGE RATE; again: GATE SWNG. It plays a SYNTH or POLY track's keys one note at a time, in time
open the mixer and keep it up
the mixer while held; letting go returns to the page
down: the reset (scl-held); on its own, nothing
held: a knob turned goes to its default, the page's own pad resets the page (scl-held). SAVE held puts back what the hold reset. (The system menu proposed here before needs another place)

start / stop the transport: every track's tape plays its loop from the start (STOP fades them out in 2 ms); an arpeggiator's notes held with no key down (latched, piled up, a project's) start and stop with it

arm / disarm the focused track's tape: while playing it records the other tracks' mix (old x DUB + new x GAIN); armed on a reel, the reel is copied onto the tape first (refused if the tape holds a take). Playing: as REC goes down (a punch-in lands where it's pressed); stopped: as it's let go
held a second while stopped: the USB record mode (the tracks stop, the output plays the computer); playing: a hint to stop first
READY: start the take; RECORDING: stop it; CHOOSE: put it on the picked track (its tape replaced) and leave
back a step: RECORDING or CHOOSE: the take thrown away; READY: leave
CHOOSE: the track the take goes to (1..TRACKS)
CHOOSE: START, where the kept part begins (a block, 11.6 ms, a detent; faster turned fast)
CHOOSE: LENGTH of the kept part (the rest goes back to memory when it's kept)
CHOOSE: GAIN, -24..+24 dB; past +24: NORM (the loudest point to full scale)
CHOOSE: FADE at both cut points, 0..500 ms (10 ms to start with)

save into the project loaded or saved last (P1 to start with); a track's own tape with a take goes into a user reel named after the project and track (P2T3), and SAVE says which tapes found no reel free

undo the last clear: the tape (POLY held, while nothing has been recorded over it), the track's modulation (MONO held) or a DRUM pattern (POLY held on a DRUM track, or PATN turned over an edited pattern), whichever came last
the white keys an octave down (SYNTH's and POLY's notes, RESONATOR's root; on DRUM's own pages: the bar, page:drum)
the white keys an octave up
the first value on the strip (and it becomes the page's last-turned: the visualization names it)
the second value on the strip
the third value on the strip
the fourth value on the strip
the global tempo, 40..240 BPM
open the project view (PROJECTS), pointing at the project loaded last
open REC IN (the routing view): what each track's REC records

TAPE: slice n of the focused track's loop (16 slices); playing: the head jumps there (crossfaded); stopped: that slice plays once. SYNTH and POLY: notes, key n the semitone n above C of OCT (until RESONATOR and SEQ give the keys their own jobs)
mute / unmute track 1 (with SETUP's KEYS on NOTE no black key is a shortcut: they play the sharps on SYNTH and POLY, F3-G5 with the white keys)
mute / unmute track 2
mute / unmute track 3
mute / unmute track 4
the focused track's tape: reverse on / off (TAPE 2's REV) (a TAPE track; on another source a message says so and the tape is left alone)
the focused track's tape: half speed on / off (TAPE 2's HALF) (a TAPE track; on another source a message says so and the tape is left alone)
global pitch shift down (unmuted tracks)
global pitch shift up (unmuted tracks)
held 0.5 s: clear the focused track's modulation (every depth of its four slots; the slots' own knobs stay; a slot's pad held too: only that slot's on the page shown, see slot-held); SAVE held undoes
held 0.5 s: clear the focused track's tape (a reel: the track goes back to its own tape, cleared); SAVE held undoes
momentary global granular freeze while held: every GRAIN buffer stops recording and its grains loop the held bars (SCAN TAPE: the cursor stops); FROZEN on the GRAIN page
the freeze latched until the next tap (its LED lit), as a tapped GLO latches the mixer: the right hand is free for GRAIN's knobs
play from slice n of the loop (finger drumming, stutter)
on a TAPE track: GRAIN's cursor to sixteenth n of the tape's loop (SCAN TAPE) or of the buffer (POS: the spot, DLY: the trail); the tape's head stays; stopped, grains while the key is held
(the key, not the POLY source engine) letting go before 0.5 s cancels the clear
the next page (PATTERN, VARY, KIT, STEP), round, as HOME is let go (as on every source), so HOME can be held for what follows
held + a white key: STEP's instrument (INST), heard; held + SELECT: the source, as on every track

PATTERN, VARY, KIT: the kit, key n left to right BD SD CP RS LC LB HB CL CB MA TB GU HH OH MB CY. STEP by MODE: HITS toggles step n of the bar shown for INST; ACC its accent; LIVE plays, and while playing writes it at the nearest step (not struck again when the step comes); ERAS wipes it as the playhead passes while held (silent)
PATTERN, VARY, KIT: KNOB 1..4 are that instrument's own TUNE DEC LVL TONE while held (the header's box names it)

PATTERN: PATN writes its rhythm over the pattern (an edited one kept for SAVE), LEN 2-4 bars, SWNG, ACNT. VARY: SEED (0: as written; each other value a version that varies the pattern the way a player would), VARY, FILL, EVOL. KIT: TUNE DEC TONE DRV over every instrument. STEP: INST BAR MODE LVL
(DRUM's own pages; the track's device pages: the octave, as on every track) the bar STEP shows, down
(DRUM's own pages) the bar STEP shows, up, within LEN
held 0.5 s: clear the DRUM pattern (its tape stays); SAVE held undoes
the strings' root, a semitone a key from C of OCT (until PTCH is turned): on a TAPE track the key plucks them too; on SYNTH or POLY the keys still play the source and the strings follow its notes
on a SEQ slot's page: pick steps 1-16 (held keys are framed on screen); the keys don't play the track here
on a SEQ slot's page with white keys held: the held steps' values (0-100 %), instead of LEN
track 1 level (the fader's notches; its fill is the live meter)
track 2 level
track 3 level
track 4 level
close the mixer
close the mixer and focus the source (any page pad does the same for its page)
the selected track's channel: KNOB 1-4 set LOW HIGH FILT PAN; letting go returns to the levels

steps the pages, each latched (as a tapped GLO latches the mixer): LEVELS, CHANNEL (the selected track's LOW HIGH FILT PAN), MASTER (the compressor: AMT ATK REL MIX), SETUP (KEYS KNOB HOLD LEDS: the panel's preferences, kept for the instrument), LEVELS
focus track 1..4 (the white keys don't play while GLO is held)
the four track levels; letting go of GLO returns to the page

TRACKS 1-4: the tracks in use; the ones above it park (silent, not rendered, their tapes taken first when memory runs short). A pad held + SELECT picks that pad's thing, as HOME + SELECT (the source) and a slot + SELECT (its engine); plain SELECT stays the tempo on every view
back to the page if something was done or it was held past HOLD; else the mixer stays up
SETUP's KEYS flipped: the black keys as the shortcuts, or as notes (the 27 keys a keyboard from F on SYNTH and POLY)

the depth (-100..100 %) from this slot to that knob on the page shown: a device, the source (each source its own depths), the channel strip. The strip shows the slot's depths while it's held; a modulated knob gets a mark. Not the reel choices; at most 32 depths a track. Turned back to 0 it catches there (gone): a turn that keeps going stays at 0 until the knob rests 250 ms, then goes on into the other sign. Let go: the page stays
held 0.5 s with the pad: clear that slot's depths on the page shown (other slots', other pages' stay); the pad let go first calls it off. SAVE held undoes
that slot's engine (LFO ADSR FOLLOW: the SEQ pad's stays a SEQ, and says so), starting from that engine's defaults; its depths stay; the tempo is left alone
the LFO pad held: it shows M3 from now (a knob turned next sets M3's depth; let go without one: M3's page). Other pads: the key's own job
the LFO pad held: it shows M2 from now (a knob turned next sets M2's depth; let go without one: M2's page). Other pads: the key's own job
the LFO pad held: it shows M1 from now (a knob turned next sets M1's depth; let go without one: M1's page). Other pads: the key's own job
held + SELECT, from any page: the track's source engine, TAPE, SYNTH, POLY, DRUM, shown on its first page; each keeps its own knobs, the switch crossfades
the depth for that step only (p-lock); release the key and pad to commit (waiting on a decision: SEQ's step values are in, per-step depths are not)
that knob to its default (any view with knobs: a page, the mixer's levels, channel and master, REC IN); PATN is turned, not reset (it writes a pattern)
on a source page: every knob on the page shown to its default, no page turn (the page's own pad, the lit one, does this on every page)
on GRAIN or RESONATOR (or the mixer's channel and master pages): the page shown to its defaults
on COLOR or SPACE: the page shown to its defaults
on the mixer's levels: every track's level to 100
on an LFO-pad slot's page (and ENV, SEQ, ARP on theirs): the page shown to its defaults; the slot's depths stay (MONO clears those)

point at the next or previous of the six project slots (on the PRESETS page: of the eight track presets, A..H, then the eight factory ones, 1..8: DRIFT RINGS (TAPE), BASS PAD (SYNTH), KEYS SWELL (POLY), TIGHT DUB (DRUM)); past P6: FACTORY, the start-up scene
the view's pages, round: PROJECTS, PRESETS (a track's sound: source and its knobs, the devices, the channel strip, the slots and depths; not the pattern, level or REC IN), as EDIT steps the mixer's

load the slot pointed at (it stops the transport); with changes not saved, asked first: OCT+ again within 3 s. On the PRESETS page: the preset (or factory one) into the focused track, no question (SAVE held puts the track back), playing on. On an EMPTY slot: a new project there, blank (every knob at its default, every track an empty tape of its own, no pattern, no depths, 120 BPM; saved by SAVE). On FACTORY: the start-up scene (the evolving one Bryo plays with nothing saved), your projects left as they are
leave the project view (any page pad does too)

save into the slot pointed at; over another project, asked first: SAVE again within 3 s. On the PRESETS page: the focused track saved as the preset pointed at (over another, asked the same way); a factory one can't be saved over (FACTORY: SAVE INTO A..H). On FACTORY: it says to save into P1..P6
held 0.5 s: delete the project pointed at (the user reels it saved stay); on the PRESETS page, the preset (a factory one stays); FACTORY stays
nothing (the view has no knobs)
the focused track's REC IN (AUTO OTHR T1-T4; its own number: SELF)
track 1..4's REC IN: AUTO (as before: the others on TAPE, its own source on SYNTH or POLY), OTHR (the others' mix), T1-T4 (one track; its own: SELF)
leave REC IN for the source (any page pad does the same for its page; GLO for the mixer)
MODE (OFF KEY LTCH ADD), ORDR (UP DOWN UPDN RND PLAY), RNGE (1-3 octaves), RATE (1/4 1/8 8T 1/16 16T 1/32); page 2: GATE, SWNG
held 0.5 s: forget the notes the arpeggiator holds (a latched chord, an ADD pile)
on a SYNTH or POLY track: the notes it arpeggiates (KEY: while held; LTCH: the last chord goes on; ADD: each joins for good)
